name: Kotake-Mukaihara
tagline: Shinjuku in 20 minutes and Shibuya in 25 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Nerima City, where Seibu and Tokyo Metro run 3 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 29 minutes to Otemachi, 20 minutes to Shinjuku, 25 minutes to Shibuya and 46 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 34.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 7.8 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 34.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 29.2 m to 37 m, a difference of 7.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

groceries.name: アコレ 小竹向原駅

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 1 clinic and 1 pharmacy. The nearest hospital is 東京武蔵野病院, about 8 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 練馬総合病院, about 19 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station. Seibu Yurakucho Line run through it. Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line also call here. Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line are available too. The lines are split between operators (Seibu runs 1 line and Tokyo Metro runs 2 lines), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line runs at 153% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 東池袋→護国寺, which this station is not on. Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line runs at 117%. Its busiest stretch is 要町→池袋, which this station is likewise not on. Seibu Yurakucho Line runs at 102% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 新桜台→小竹向原, which includes this station. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 2LDK ¥180,000 to ¥190,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Ekoda is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Kotake-Mukaihara is ahead on the number of lines and quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Kotake-Mukaihara.

neighbours.lead: Shin-Sakuradai is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Kotake-Mukaihara is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It takes 8 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Kotake-Mukaihara.

noiseSources: 要町通り (a main road) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 3 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
